test_albert_tokenization: test the AlbertTokenizer by running the AlbertTokenizationTest unittest suite with sentencepiece and tokenizers backends
run_albert_tokenizer_from_pretrained: run AlbertTokenizer.from_pretrained to load the albert-base-v1 tokenizer and tokenize input text into token IDs
build_albert_tokenizer_from_vocab: build an AlbertTokenizer from raw vocab scores and merges extracted via SentencePieceExtractor
extract_sentencepiece_vocab: extract vocabulary IDs, scores, and merges from a SentencePiece model file using SentencePieceExtractor
review_albert_tokenization_test: review the AlbertTokenizationTest class and its integration expected tokens and decoded text outputs
